classes.title: py_compile dirties a clean-tree proof
classes.summary: A workflow run block compiles Python without suppressing bytecode and later asserts a clean checkout in the same block.

classes.title: GitHub expression interpolation inside multiline run
classes.summary: A multiline run block contains a ${{ ... }} expression; move the value through env or an explicit file/input boundary instead.

classes.title: Evidence artifact uploads under if: always()
classes.summary: An actions/upload-artifact step is guarded by if: always(), allowing failed or stale proof material to be retained as if it were authoritative evidence.

classes.title: Reducer coerces malformed input into a valid-looking value
classes.summary: Strict reducers should reject malformed values instead of normalizing them into admissible evidence.

classes.title: Carrier pins a donor blob it does not carry
classes.summary: A proof carrier names an immutable donor blob but does not include or otherwise durably resolve that exact blob.

classes.title: Falsy value silently replaced by a default
classes.summary: Patterns such as value or default can rewrite legitimate false/zero/empty inputs when the contract distinguishes them from missing data.

classes.title: Strict reducer rejects its own supposed-good fixture
classes.summary: After tightening a reducer, the positive control must still use the exact accepted panel/schema and reach the decision boundary.

classes.title: Whole-file transcription drifts unrelated bytes
classes.summary: A narrow edit to a large structured file should preserve unrelated bytes/semantics instead of retyping or reserializing the entire postimage.
